# 15-Minute Precipitation Nowcast

No 15-minute precipitation model covers this location. Native 15-minute data is available only in the contiguous US and nearby Canada and Mexico (HRRR) and in Central Europe (ICON-D2). This is not a forecast of dry weather. Use granularity "hourly" for an hour-by-hour forecast here.
